text:
rachel (growth): Heads-up: global benchmark webinar on May 12. Need owners for reg page, multi-geo recordings, YouTube embargo publish, and lead routing. Can we lock today?

vik (events): I can do Zoom config + regional meeting links. Plan: single global meeting with 3 regional co-hosts and staggered local start slides. Need list of alt hosts and approved speakers.

hannah (producer): I own capture + post-prod. Two asks: 1) we must produce separate per-region raw files (na, eu, apac) for legal/consent reasons; 2) embargo policy on publishing (48h internal review).

leo (product): Reg page fields: name, email, company, company size (range), role, country, timezone, recording_consent (yes/no), and a short use-case textbox. Hidden utm params please. Also add a dropdown "publish permission" with options: public, internal-only, no-publish.

rachel (growth): Perfect. HubSpot mapping: campaign=benchmarks-may, source=webinar, publish_permission -> contact property `webinar_publish_pref`. We should exclude "no-publish" contacts from public socials via Zap filter.

vik (events): Zoom settings checklist: require registration (auto-approve), cloud recording ON, audio transcript enable, alternative hosts: hannah + regional ops, disable file transfer, set chat to host-only. For multi-geo capture I'll enable local recording on each regional co-host machine as backup.

hannah (producer): Local backup plan: regional co-hosts will record locally to SSD. Naming convention: `bench_{YYYYMMDD}_{region}_{raw,edit}.mp4`. I'll collect via secure upload link. I will also record an OBS RTMP fallback to `rtmp://ingest.redwood.global/live` and stash keys in 1Password.

rachel (growth): Embargo workflow: 1) Hannah uploads raw to staging S3, 2) Product/legal review within 24h, 3) Marketing approves for public, 4) Hannah publishes to YouTube as unlisted then schedule to public at approved time. Who owns step 2?

leo (product): Legal review owner: me for customer-sensitive segments, else assign to legal@redwood. I'll triage within 12h. Add a metadata tag `sensitive=true/false` on the asset upload form.

hannah (producer): For accessibility: I'll generate .vtt captions and plain-text transcript, plus an auto-translated Spanish captions file for EU/LatAm socials. We should note translated captions are machine-generated and flagged as such.

vik (events): Lead routing: Zapier will push registrants into HubSpot and add SFDC sync for MQLs. Zap should map `publish_permission` and `recording_consent`. I'll post the Zap JSON and test result.

rachel (growth): Post-event cadence: Day0: thank-you + replay placeholder (private link), Day2: highlights + CTA, Day5: full replay + transcript (public if approved). Also schedule paid socials only after publish_permission=public.

hannah (producer): Timeline: raw -> staging within 6h, edited highlights (2-min) within 24h, full edit within 72h. If legal flags content, timeline pauses and marketing gets notified.

leo (product): Small privacy ask: disable in-meeting file transfer and screenshare annotations from guests. Add a slide at start explaining recording and reuse policy.

vik (events): Ops pin I'll post: 1) Reg page live + test, 2) Zoom + alt hosts, 3) Regional local backups confirmed, 4) Zap -> HubSpot test passed, 5) Pre-show T-30 run, 6) Asset handoff & embargo flow.

rachel (growth): Owners: Reg page & forms=leo, Zoom & run=vik, Capture & edits=hannah, Post-event cadence & paid social=rachel. Everyone ok?

hannah (producer): All good. I'll also produce a 30s social cut and a vertical 9:16 teaser within 24h for paid.

zoom-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Redwood Global Benchmarks" Tue 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC. Recording: cloud enabled.
